theorems.statement: ∀ (n ℓ : ℕ) (U : Set (Rn n)) (G : Rn n → Amb n ℓ) (x : Rn n) (ρ ε : ℝ), IsOpen U → ContDiffOn ℝ 1 G U → x ∈ U → 0 < ε → ∀ᶠ t in 𝓝[>] (0 : ℝ), (∀ v ∈ closedBall (0 : Rn n) ρ, x + t • v ∈ U) ∧ ∀ v ∈ closedBall (0 : Rn n) ρ, ∀ v' ∈ closedBall (0 : Rn n) ρ, ‖t⁻¹ • (G (x + t • v) - G (x + t • v')) - fderiv ℝ G x (v - v')‖ ≤ ε * ‖v - v'‖
